text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — our cross-functional engineering sync next week has a packed agenda (RFC reviews + roadmap triage). Can we lock an agenda owner and decide if we move to 40m instead of 30m?

Dan Varela: I'm +1 for 40m if it means we can avoid follow-ups. will need a clear timebox for RFCs.

Sophie Li: I have a design review that day, timezone is rough for APAC. Maybe alternate weekly slots?

Raj Patel: Alternating works for platform folks. We should also pre-publish the RFCs to review so reviewers can triage offline.

Olivia Grant: I'll own the agenda for next week if folks are ok — I'll collect RFC links and 3 bullet TL;DRs from each author by EOD Tue. :+1:

Maria Chen: Thanks Olivia — can you also own the live timeboxing? Suggest format: 10m quick updates, 15m RFC deep-dive, 10m triage picks, 5m action review.

Dan Varela: That split seems sane. For RFCs: can we require a 1-paragraph decision ask at top of each doc? saves time.

Sophie Li: Agreed on the decision ask. Also request: mark any cross-team dependencies with @mentions in the doc.

Raj Patel: If we go 40m, I suggest adding a 5m buffer for overruns and escalations — or we stick strictly to 35m and defer.

Maria Chen: Option A: official 40m meeting with strict 35m agenda + 5m overrun. Option B: keep 30m and run RFC deep-dives as separate follow-ups. Which do folks prefer?

Dan Varela: Option A and alternate weekly times for APAC.

Olivia Grant: Option A sounds best. I'll update the calendar and add a short pre-read checklist in the invite.

schedule-bot: Poll created — link: https://poll.service/7f3a (vote by EOD Friday).

Sophie Li: One more ask: can we pin the RFCs in the meeting thread and add a short rubric for reviewers (safety/perf/UX) so people know what to look for?

Maria Chen: Great idea, Sophie. Olivia — can you include the rubric in the invite and pin the docs in this channel when you post?

Olivia Grant: Yep — will post invite w/ checklist + rubric by Tue 18:00 PST and tag authors to submit TL;DRs.

Dan Varela: I'll start prepping the heatmap of priorities to help triage.

Raj Patel: Noted. Action items: (1) Olivia = agenda owner next week + calendar update, (2) Authors = RFC TL;DR + decision ask by Tue EOD, (3) Dan = priority heatmap, (4) Sophie = reviewer rubric request.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. If the poll lands on alternate slot we rotate; otherwise we go with Option A and publish a decision log after the meeting.

Olivia Grant: Done — calendar updated and poll link in the invite. :white_check_mark:

Dan Varela: Thanks, all.

Sophie Li: Thanks!

Raj Patel: 👍
